title: EventEnvelope
description: Shared envelope of every domain event (SAD 7.1). Each event schema in this folder composes it with allOf and narrows event_type, event_version, producer and data. The envelope is closed: adding or removing an envelope field is a breaking change for every consumer.

event_id.description: Unique per event. Consumers record it in processed_events to stay idempotent (SAD 6.3).

event_version.description: Schema version of data. Changes only on a breaking change (SAD 7.4).

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened in the publishing service, ISO-8601 in UTC (SAD 11.1).

producer.description: Publishing service. Only the five services with an outbox publish events (SAD 6.3).

tenant_id.description: Restaurant the event belongs to (SAD 8.2). Present on every event; for restaurant.* events it equals data.restaurant_id.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID of the request that caused the event (SAD 13.2).

data.description: Event payload, defined per event type. Open to additional properties: consumers ignore fields they do not know (SAD 7.4 rule 1).
